title: Instrumentation Is Placement Evidence, Not Placement Authority
summary: Instrumentation Mesh contributes health, freshness, state and bounded operational events to route explanation and ordering without acquiring admission, placement, release or execution authority.
why: Operational visibility is useful precisely because it can be consumed broadly without silently becoming a second scheduler or allocator.
invariants: Health and freshness are separate dimensions.
STALE observation can lower preference but does not itself make an otherwise-authoritatively-admissible resource illegal.
Missing telemetry is UNKNOWN, not fabricated failure.
Instrumentation events do not carry workload payloads, prompts, credentials or arbitrary compute objects.
Observation cannot mint, renew or release a placement lease.
evidence_note: Grounded in oorexx_instrumentation_mesh_v0.1-dev7 and Generalized Compute Intentions v0.1-dev5 Mesh integration tests.
